references.text: David encourages seeking refuge in the Lord, which resembles the idea of praying in secret as mentioned in Matthew 6:6
The encouragement to go into one's room and shut the door behind for a little while until anger passes can be seen as parallel to praying in secret
Jesus withdraws to pray alone, reflecting the principle of private prayer in Matthew 6:6
Jesus often withdraws to lonely places to pray, emphasizing the importance of private prayer
A warning against hypocritical prayer done to be seen by others, highlighting the importance of sincerity in prayer as in verse 6
